description: Conditional price reversal with multiple lookback periods and neutralization groups. Tests reversal effects across different timeframes (3-20 days) and group structures to find optimal mean-reversion parameters for GLB/TOPDIV3000.
hypothesis: Short-term price reversals (3-20 days) exhibit mean-reversion behavior across GLB equities. Recent losers outperform recent winners over the next period. Different lookback windows and neutralization groups may capture different reversal regimes - faster reversals (3-5 days) vs slower corrections (10-20 days).
source: Custom template - multi-parameter reversal strategy based on public BRAIN reversal patterns (similar to ashare_short_reversal but parameterized for GLB)
expected_correlation: Negative correlation with momentum strategies; low correlation with value factors

failure_risks.LOW_SHARPE: GLB markets may have weaker reversal effects than A-shares
failure_risks.HIGH_TURNOVER: Short lookback periods create high turnover; decay and truncation help mitigate
failure_risks.MOMENTUM_REGIME: In strong momentum regimes, reversals may underperform
